result_text:
I fixed the four default scoping conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add tests for the new matches, so the `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases are untested.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group was `(html|html|xhtml)`, a duplicated `html`. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. The content checks (`<doc>` within 2 lines, `// Generated by` on line 1) still decide which files match, so ordinary hand-written `.xml` and `.js` files stay out.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** the pattern was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. A file literally named `.-gradle.js` also still matches.

I didn't commit anything.
